input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Base Terms contain no express minimum purchase, volume or take-or-pay commitment (§ 4.1 charges are one-time, installment, recurring or usage-based, and § 3.5 limits Customer's liability on termination to accrued amounts). However, § 3.4(b) conditions Customer's termination-for-convenience right on payment of undefined "early termination charges" specified in Attachment A and Service Option Attachments, which — combined with automatic renewal for terms of equal duration under § 3.2 — creates an open-ended penalty for exiting and functions as take-or-pay exposure for Services never received. Per the playbook we narrowed the exit payment to a true-up of IBM's unavoidable direct costs and confirmed no minimum purchase or volume commitment, preserving the existing one-month exit right.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying, in lieu of any early termination charge, penalty or minimum purchase or volume commitment, a true-up equal to IBM's actual, reasonable and documented direct costs attributable to the terminated Services that IBM cannot reasonably avoid or mitigate. Customer will have no obligation to pay for Services not rendered.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not take take-or-pay exposure, so we have replaced the open-ended early termination charges referenced to Attachment A with a true-up limited to IBM's unavoidable direct costs and confirmed there is no minimum purchase or volume commitment. If IBM needs term protection, we can accept a commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, provided any exit payment remains a true-up rather than a penalty.
proposal.summary: Convert Section 3.4(b) early termination charges into an unavoidable-cost true-up and confirm no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
